items.title: August Lanoix Interview, 1961-04-19
items.q: He wasn't exactly a teacher, but he was a very good musician.

ctx.x: No, I went under professor with the bass horn. The bass horn.
Chalinday? Went to... No. Humphrey again?
No, wait. He was... He wasn't exactly a teacher, but he was a very good musician.
